annotations.title: Find which French legal notices a company must publish

description: Use this when a French company or its adviser describes a corporate event (creation, registered office transfer within or outside the department, change of manager or president, name, corporate purpose, share capital, legal form, duration, dissolution, liquidation closure, sale of a business…) and needs to know which legal notices are mandatory, how many, in which department, on what legal basis and at what price. The answer comes from a fixed table of rules; when it needs one more fact, it returns a question instead of a guess. Do not use for court-ordered insolvency notices or for legal advice on whether to take the decision.

department.description: Department of the registered office (before a transfer).

legalForm.description: Current legal form (required for company_creation and legal_form_change).

newDepartment.description: Department of the new registered office (seat_transfer).

sameCommercialCourt.description: seat_transfer within one department that has several commercial courts: does the new office depend on the same court?

soleShareholderIsCompany.description: dissolution_without_liquidation: is the sole shareholder a company?
